title: Effect of head motion-induced artefacts on the reliability of deep learning-based whole-brain segmentation
summary: Across 110 participants, deep-learning segmentation remained more consistent than FreeSurfer across radiologist-rated image-quality levels. The result concerns segmentation reliability under motion, not diagnostic benefit; conclusions are limited to evaluated sequences and methods.
ai_technology: FastSurferCNN, Kwyk and ReSeg neural-network segmentation are compared with FreeSurfer on rest and active-motion MRI.
